correctness.rationale: The all-divisor recurrence has coefficient generating function 1/(2 product(1-x_j)-1). By a genuine formal binomial-series elimination, the symmetric finite nested expression has the identical multivariate series. The final index sums to 2^a_w and yields the exact conjecture. All coefficientwise operations have unit-constant denominators. Width one, zero exponents, and the n=1 exception are treated. A separate checker confirms 770 finite tuples, not replacing proof.

value.rationale: The proof resolves the author's explicitly published Conjecture 1 about an efficient nonnegative finite formula, uniformly over all factorization signatures. Earlier formulas evaluated the same arithmetic function but the identity of this specific positive binomial expression was posed as an open problem. It is a reusable formal-series method for nested convolution identities, not a routine table update.
